00022 /**

00076 /**
00077  * @brief       Create a menu item
00078  *
00079  * HxMenuItemNew creates a new menu item. Its reference count is set to 1.
00080  *
00081  * If the type is kHxMenuSubmenu, pData points to the HxMenu_t submenu, and
00082  * the reference count of the submenu is incremented by 1. To listen to 
00083  * a specific menu item action use the kHxMenuItemIDSelected message.
00084  * See messagedomain.h for more information.
00085  *
00086  * The icon associated with the menu item should have an alpha channel
00087  * to properly render with a transparent background.  Color-keyed
00088  * icons are not supported.
00089  *
00090  * @param id            IN:     Unique ID for the menu item, defined by app,
00091  *                              or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
00092  * @param pString       IN:     String displayed by menu item
00093  * @param type          IN:     Type of the menu item
00094  * @param state         IN:     Initial state of the menu item
00095  * @param pIcon         IN:     Left icon associated with the item or NULL.
00096  * @param shortcut      IN:     Shortcut character or 0 for no shortcut.
00097  * @param pData         IN:     NULL or an optional submenu. 
00098  * @param hItem         OUT:    Handle to the created menu item,
00099  *                              set to NULL on failure
00100  *
00101  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00102  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.
00103  *
00104  **/
00105 HxResult HxMenuItemNew(uint32_t id, const char* pString, HxMenuItemType type,
00106                        int32_t state, HxImageDescription_t* pIcon,
00107                        char shortcut, void* pData, HxMenuItem_t** hItem);
00108

00218  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00219  *
00220  **/
00221 HxResult HxMenuRegisterShortcut(HxMenu_t* pMenu, uint32_t id,
00222                                 int32_t shortcut);

00256 /**
00257  * @brief               Add a scrollable item to a menu
00258  * 
00259  * HxMenuAddMarker adds a menu item which appears within a potentially
00260  * scrollable region of the menu. If enough markers are added to the
00261  * same menu, the markers will scroll, instead of expand, hiding items
00262  * that might not fit on the screen. The scrollable region of any menu
00263  * always occurs at the bottom of the menu, below normal menu items.
00264  * To listen to a specific menu marker action use the
00265  * kHxMenuMarkerSelected or kHxMenuMarkerIDSelected message. See
00266  * messagedomain.h for more information. Markers may not be added to
00267  * the root menu.
00268  *
00269  * @param pMenu         IN:     Pointer to a menu
00270  * @param fileId        IN:     associated id with the file, cannot be 0
00271  * @param display       IN:     string to be displayed on the menu
00272  * 
00273  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00274  *
00275  **/
00276 HxResult HxMenuAddMarker(HxMenu_t* pMenu, uint32_t itemID,
00277                          const char* display);

00356 /**
00357  * @brief               Show a menu
00358  *
00359  * HxMenuShow shows the menu at the specified coordinates. The x and y
00360  * coordinates are ignored for root menus.  A kHxMenuAboutToShow
00361  * message will be sent to alert the application.  If the menu is
00362  * already showing, this call will do nothing; if you need to move the
00363  * menu on the screen, you should hide it and then show it at a new
00364  * location. Attempting to show an empty menu will result in an
00365  * assertion in debug builds or return invalid area returned release
00366  * builds.
00367  *
00368  * If the popup menu would extend off the edge of the screen with the
00369  * provided x and y coordinates, it will be automatically adjusted to
00370  * fit onto the screen by moving it up or to the left.
00371  *
00372  * @param pMenu         IN:     Pointer to menu
00373  * @param x             IN:     x coordinate of menu
00374  * @param y             IN:     y coordinate of menu
00375  *
00376  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00377  **/
00378 HxResult HxMenuShow(HxMenu_t* pMenu, int32_t x, int32_t y);
